title: A Computer-Based Methodology to Design Non-Standard Peptides Potentially Able to Prevent HOX-PBX1-Associated Cancer Diseases.
authors: Gulotta, Maria Rita; De Simone, Giada; John, Justin; Perricone, Ugo; Brancale, Andrea
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟和MM-GBSA计算设计非标准肽以抑制HOX-PBX1与DNA的复合物结合，虽聚焦于肽抑制剂设计而非TF-DNA结合机制本身，但以HOX-PBX1-DNA三元复合物为体系，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模。
abstract: In the last decades, HOX proteins have been extensively studied due to their pivotal role in transcriptional events. HOX proteins execute their activity by exploiting a cooperative binding to PBX proteins and DNA. Therefore, an increase or decrease in HOX activity has been associated with both solid and haematological cancer diseases. Thus, inhibiting HOX-PBX interaction represents a potential strategy to prevent these malignancies, as demonstrated by the patented peptide HTL001 that is being studied in clinical trials. In this work, a computational study is described to identify novel potential peptides designed by employing a database of non-natural amino acids. For this purpose, residue scanning of the HOX minimal active sequence was performed to select the mutations to be further processed. According to these results, the peptides were point-mutated and used for Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations in complex with PBX1 protein and DNA to evaluate complex binding stability. MM-GBSA calculations of the resulting MD trajectories were exploited to guide the selection of the most promising mutations that were exploited to generate twelve combinatorial peptides. Finally, the latter peptides in complex with PBX1 protein and DNA were exploited to run MD simulations and the DeltaG(binding) average values of the complexes were calculated. Thus, the analysis of the results highlighted eleven combinatorial peptides that will be considered for further assays.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，HOX蛋白因其在转录事件中的关键作用而受到广泛研究。HOX蛋白通过与PBX蛋白及DNA的协同结合来发挥其活性。因此，HOX活性的增强或减弱与实体瘤和血液系统癌症疾病均有关联。因此，抑制HOX-PBX相互作用代表了一种预防这些恶性肿瘤的潜在策略，正如已获专利的肽HTL001所证明的那样，该肽正在临床试验中研究。本研究描述了一项计算研究，旨在通过使用非天然氨基酸数据库设计新型潜在肽。为此，对HOX最小活性序列进行了残基扫描，以选择进一步处理的突变。根据这些结果，对肽进行了点突变，并与PBX1蛋白和DNA形成复合物进行分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟，以评估复合物结合稳定性。利用所得MD轨迹的MM-GBSA计算来指导选择最有前景的突变，并利用这些突变生成了十二种组合肽。最后，将这些肽与PBX1蛋白和DNA形成的复合物用于运行MD模拟，并计算了复合物的DeltaG(binding)平均值。因此，结果分析突出了十一种组合肽，将考虑用于进一步的实验。
